title: PairPlay Motion
user: Friends and families with spare phones or split Joy-Cons who want a frictionless motion-controller party-game setup in a browser.
smallest_useful_product: A QR-pairing PWA with a host screen, two-phone motion calibration, and three original 2–4 player reaction games; it runs over local Wi-Fi and shows an explicit permission screen.
success_measure: Two first-time players reach a calibrated playable round within 90 seconds on supported mobile browsers, with at least 80% completing a five-minute session.
constraints: Motion-sensor access requires browser permission and iOS-specific handling; use LAN/WebRTC where possible, do not retain sensor streams, and disclose that low-end devices vary.
